items.title: Moderna stock pulls back after massive one-day rally: analysts weigh in
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moderna shares pulled back sharply on Thursday, giving up a small chunk of Wednesday’s record-breaking rally after the stock rocketed as much as 177% on data showing its personalized cancer vaccine, developed with Merck, slowed the spread and recurrence of melanoma. Merck shares had jumped 12.6% on Wednesday alongside Moderna’s surge.
